demoQuestions.q: What's the cost of the Cybersecurity AAS?
demoQuestions.a: CPCC's Cybersecurity AAS tuition is set by the NC Community College System. In-state students pay roughly the per-credit-hour rate published on cpcc.edu/financial-aid; the AAS requires ~64 credits over 4–6 semesters. Sources: cpcc.edu/financial-aid, catalog.cpcc.edu/programs/cybersecurity.
